name: Integrated WTI Forecast
price_interpretation: median of the calibrated log-return distribution transformed to price

fixed_path_metrics.interpretation: 17 targets from one fixed origin, not 17 independent forecasts

limitations: Base specifications use the full historical development window. Meta forecasts are coefficient-cross-fitted conditional on these specifications, not a fully nested unbiased historical test.
Retrospective held-out evaluation; October was inspected in prior module work. No October observations or scores select fusion parameters.
At least 5% per point member, fixed before fusion evaluation to satisfy all-member integration; optimum is conditional on this constraint.
October daily h=1/5 did not beat random walk; long horizons have no realized test targets.
